AZPhoto to be added for Dr A. Zarkali

Principal Investigator

Dr A. Zarkali

I am a neurologist with an interest in cognitive neurology and movement disorders. My clinical and research interest is the aetiology, diagnosis and treatment of Lewy Body Disease. Specifically, my research aims to shed light on the brain circuits responsible for cognitive decline in Lewy body disease and use non-invasive stimulation as a novel approach to treatment. a.zarkali [at] ucl.ac.uk
